catalogDescription: Open a LinkedIn profile, add the role, and get recruiter-ready candidate notes in seconds.
title: LinkedIn Candidate Screener
subtitle: Role-fit screening and recruiter notes directly from the LinkedIn workflow.
descriptionBody:
LinkedIn Candidate Screener helps recruiters, HR teams, and founders hiring directly make faster first-pass decisions. It reads the visible profile, combines it with the target role and optional resume, and returns structured notes instead of a generic summary.

The result is not just a profile recap. It is a role-fit screen with recruiter-ready notes, fit signals, risks, and interview checks that a hiring team can reuse immediately.
section1Title: A faster first-pass screen without leaving LinkedIn
section1Body: Open the profile you are already reviewing, add the role or JD, optionally include resume text and visible activity, and get a compact screen that helps you decide whether the candidate deserves the next step. The workflow is built for speed, but the output stays structured enough to share with the team.
featuresTitle: What the first version helps with:

features.name: Role-fit screening
features.desc: Evaluates the visible LinkedIn profile against a target role instead of producing a generic profile summary.

features.name: Recruiter-ready notes
features.desc: Returns verdict, fit signals, risks, interview checks, and internal notes that are easier to share.

features.name: Optional enrichment
features.desc: Lets the screener include resume text, visible recent activity, and selected external links when that context helps.

features.name: Fast local testing
features.desc: Works as a lightweight Chrome extension instead of forcing teams into a heavy ATS workflow before they know if it helps.

whyTitle: Why use this instead of a generic AI prompt?

whyPoints.title: It works inside the hiring flow
whyPoints.desc: You stay on the LinkedIn profile you are already reviewing instead of copying everything into another tool.

whyPoints.title: It screens against a role
whyPoints.desc: The output is built around fit, gaps, and interview verification rather than a broad descriptive summary.

whyPoints.title: It produces reusable notes
whyPoints.desc: The structure is closer to recruiter notes than to a chat response, which makes internal sharing much easier.

footerSummaryDetails: LinkedIn Candidate Screener is freemium. Get 3 free candidate screens per month, or upgrade to 25 screens per month (with additional options for more screenings).
footerResultDetails: A fast first-pass candidate screen with recruiter notes your team can scan, discuss, and reuse.
whoThisIsFor: Founders screening candidates quickly against active roles.
HR teams who want cleaner first-pass notes before a manager review.
Founders hiring directly without a full recruiting stack yet.
Lean teams who want to test better screening without heavy process overhead.

faq.q: Does it scrape LinkedIn in the background?
faq.a: No. The first version is designed as a user-invoked screening tool that reads the visible profile when you choose to run a screen.

faq.q: Can I include a resume too?
faq.a: Yes. You can paste resume text into the extension to give the screen more context when you have it.

faq.q: Is this an ATS or sourcing platform?
faq.a: No. The first version is a focused candidate-screening extension, not a full recruiting platform.
